_comment: Binds the compiled ConfidentialPool runtime to the artifact that was reviewed. verify-pool-size.sh asserts (a) runtime <= 24576 (EIP-170, ALWAYS hard-fail), (b) the set of library link references matches link_references, and (c) keccak(LINK-NORMALIZED runtime) == runtime_keccak. The pool delegatecalls ReflectionLib, so the compiled runtime carries `__$<hash>$__` placeholders until a library address is chosen; the hash is taken with every placeholder zeroed, so this identity is address-independent and stable across deploy rehearsals while still catching real code or compiler drift. ANY code or compiler change must re-measure: update this file IN THE SAME COMMIT as the change, exactly like sp1/confidential/elf-vkey-pin.json. A drifting artifact is how unaudited bytecode reaches mainnet.
_link_note: The pool links exactly one library. Its ADDRESS is not pinned here (it is deploy-ceremony state): pin it in foundry.toml `libraries` before grinding the CREATE3 salt, since the linked address is baked into the pool's creation code and therefore changes both the vanity address and the deployed bytecode.
